ledger.note: 18 May 1595: the Treaty of Teusina returns Ingria to Russia. Sweden agreed to 'abandon the occupied territories of Kexholm and Ingria'; Russia received 'most of Ingria, including Ivangorod, Yama, and Koporye'. The Swedish Ingria page dates it 'ceded to Russia: 18 May 1595'; the Kingdom of Sweden dossier has the loss in 1590 on the Sweden page.

ledger.note: 9 March 1617 (27 February O.S.): the Treaty of Stolbovo gives Sweden Ingria. Sweden gained 'the province of Ingria, including the fortress of Nöteborg (now Shlisselburg)' and 'the province of Kexholm' in Karelia; Russia was to pay 20,000 rubles; Russia 'renounced all claims to Estonia and Livonia'. Kexholm is not drawn here.

notes: Type colony: a dominion of the Swedish crown governed by stadtholders and governors-general. Gap in life: the dossier has land 1583-1594 and 1617-1707; 1595-1616 is Russian (Teusina to Stolbovo) and the shape is empty. Disagreement: the Kingdom of Sweden dossier (from the Sweden page) has Sweden giving up Ingria and Kexholm in 1590 and the Teusina treaty in 1595; the Swedish Ingria page and the Teusina page agree on 18 May 1595. The page's 'Stadtholders (1601-1617)' suggests Swedish officers held part of Ingria earlier than 1617; the pages opened do not say. Kexholm County (Käkisalmi, Swedish Karelia 1617-1721) is not covered: it needs its own dossier (counterparts_needing_dossiers). Ivangorod and Narva's side of the river: Narva is in swedish-estonia. Nöteborg and the Narva-Ivangorod line use coordinates and a polygon because the gazetteer lacks Shlisselburg, Kingisepp and Ivangorod. The Ingrian War (named on the Swedish Ingria page as ended by Stolbovo) has no war entry because no opened page gives its start year.
